fusions.name: Split Circuit
fusions.desc: Fires a spark that deals 7 damage to the first enemy it meets, then forks to 2 more enemies within 4 tiles, each hit dealing 60% of the original damage. Holds 3 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Twin-Prong Discharge
fusions.desc: Arcs current between two prongs across a cone 3 tiles long, which deals 13 damage to everything in it and stuns each enemy for 1 second.

fusions.name: Junction Switch
fusions.desc: Throws a switch that clears the cooldown on one of your other abilities, chosen at random from those still waiting.

fusions.name: Bifurcated Feed
fusions.desc: Each critical hit splits off a bolt that leaps to the nearest enemy within 6 tiles and deals 6 damage. Once every 4 seconds.
